doc.title: Asset Management FAQ
doc.summary: This document provides frequently asked questions and answers regarding the Asset Management module, focusing on the definition of asset schemas, management of consumable assets, purchase orders, allocation, expiry tracking, and inventory thresholds. It guides Asset Administrators through various processes for efficient asset control.

prerequisites.name: Asset Administrator Role
prerequisites.description: User must have the Asset Administrator role assigned to perform these actions.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators define the Asset Schema by adding appropriate Asset Categories and Asset Sub-Categories for consumable assets to be recorded in the Asset Management module.
chunks.why_it_matters: This foundational step structures how all consumable assets are organized and tracked in the system, ensuring proper inventory management and data consistency.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators can add new categories specifically for consumable assets within the Asset Management (AM) module to organize inventory.
chunks.why_it_matters: Categorizing assets helps in efficient tracking, reporting, and management of different types of consumable items, improving inventory control.
how_to_use: 1. Navigate to the Asset Management module.
2. Under the Asset Schema section, click Add Category.
3. Enter the Category Name.
4. Select the Category Type as Consumable.
5. Provide a Description if required.
6. Click Save to create the new asset category for consumable assets.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators can create sub-categories under existing consumable asset categories to further refine asset organization within the Asset Management (AM) module.
chunks.why_it_matters: Sub-categories allow for more granular classification and management of consumable assets, improving inventory detail, searchability, and reporting accuracy.
how_to_use: 1. Navigate to the Asset Management module.
2. Under the Asset Schema section, click Add Sub-Category.
3. Select the Parent Category under which the new sub-category should be created.
4. Enter the Sub-Category Name and provide a Description if required.
5. Click Save to create the new sub-category for the selected category of consumable assets.

chunks.feature_name: Custom Fields for Consumable Asset Sub-Category
chunks.what_it_does: Consumable asset categories and sub-categories do not support the addition of custom fields.
chunks.why_it_matters: This clarifies a system limitation, preventing users from attempting to add unsupported data fields to consumable asset types and managing expectations.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators can add new consumable products to the inventory, specifying details like category, sub-category, product code, unit of measurement, store location, reorder threshold, and expiry handling.
chunks.why_it_matters: Adding products is essential for tracking specific items, managing stock levels, and ensuring that consumable units can be properly recorded and allocated within the system.
how_to_use: 1. Navigate to the Asset Management module and click on the Consumable Asset Section.
2. Click on the Manage Products tab.
3. Click Add Product, then select the appropriate Category and Sub-Category for the product.
4. Enter the Product Name, Product Code, and Unit of Measurement.
5. Specify the Store Location, set the Reorder Threshold, and indicate whether to Handle Expiry for the product.
6. Optionally, provide a Description and upload a Product Image.
7. Once all details are entered, click Save to add the new product to the inventory.

chunks.what_it_does: Yes, adding a Product is mandatory in the Asset Management (AM) module. The Product is a crucial part of the asset hierarchy, and consumable units can only be added under a specific product.
chunks.why_it_matters: This ensures that all consumable items are properly categorized and linked to a defined product, maintaining data integrity and enabling accurate inventory tracking and reporting.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators can create new purchase orders for consumable assets by selecting a vendor, entering purchase details, and specifying the products, costs, quantities, and expiry dates.
chunks.why_it_matters: Creating purchase orders is vital for formally documenting asset acquisitions, tracking expenses, and ensuring that new stock is properly recorded and integrated into inventory.
how_to_use: 1. Go to the Purchase Management tab in the Consumable Asset section of the Asset Management module.
2. Click on Create New Purchase, select the Vendor, and enter the Purchase Order ID, Date of Purchase, Invoice Number, Date of Invoice, Receipt Number and Date of Receipt.
3. Then, select the product being procured, cost per unit, batch quantity and Expiry Date.
4. Click on Submit to create the purchase order.

chunks.what_it_does: Consumable assets are recorded by first creating the Asset Schema (Category and Sub-Category), then adding a Product, and finally entering its Purchase Details. The platform automatically creates consumable units upon purchase, making them available for allocation.
chunks.why_it_matters: This structured recording process ensures that all consumable assets are accurately tracked from acquisition to allocation, providing a clear audit trail and facilitating inventory control.
how_to_use: 1. Create the Asset Schema by adding a Category and a Sub-Category.
2. Add a Product.
3. Enter its Purchase Details.
4. The platform automatically creates consumable units based on the quantity purchased.
5. These units are then available for allocation by asset administrators to specific departments or members as per institutional requirements.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators can allocate consumable assets to specific departments or individual members by selecting the category, sub-category, product, quantity, recipient, date, location, and purpose of the allotment.
chunks.why_it_matters: Asset allocation ensures that consumable items are distributed efficiently and tracked to their respective users or departments, maintaining accountability and accurate inventory levels.
how_to_use: 1. Go to the Allotment Tab in the Consumable Asset section of Asset Management module.
2. Click Create New Allotment.
3. Select the Category, Sub-Category, Product, and Quantity.
4. Choose the Allotted To field (Department or Member), select the Date of Allotment, Location, and Purpose.
5. Click Save to finalize the allotment.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators can manage product expiry by enabling the 'Handle Expiry' toggle when creating a product, which makes the expiry date field available for tracking products with a limited shelf life.
chunks.why_it_matters: Tracking expiry dates is crucial for managing perishable or time-sensitive consumable assets, reducing waste, and ensuring that only valid items are allocated to users.
how_to_use: 1. Enable the Handle Expiry toggle when creating a product in the Consumable Asset section of Asset Management module.
2. When this option is enabled, the expiry date field will appear in the product details, allowing asset administrators to track and manage products with a limited shelf life.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators can track inventory thresholds by setting a 'Reorder Threshold' value during product creation, which triggers a notification when stock levels fall below this minimum.
chunks.why_it_matters: Setting reorder thresholds helps prevent stockouts, ensures timely replenishment of consumable assets, and optimizes inventory levels to avoid disruptions.
how_to_use: 1. Enter the value in the Reorder Threshold field when creating or a product in the Consumable Asset section of Asset Management module to set a minimum stock level.
2. When stock falls below this threshold, the platform will notify the asset administrator to reorder the product.

chunks.what_it_does: Asset Administrators can record the return of an allotted quantity of consumable assets by accessing the specific allotment record, entering the return quantity, and processing the return to update inventory levels.
chunks.why_it_matters: Recording returns accurately updates inventory, ensures accountability for allocated items, and provides a clear record of asset movements for auditing purposes.
how_to_use: 1. Go to the Allotment Tab in the Consumable Assets module.
2. Click on the View or Return Link against the specific allotment record.
3. Once the allotment details are displayed, click on the Return Items Button.
4. Enter the Quantity to Return and click Process Return to complete the return process.
5. This will update the allotment records and adjust inventory levels accordingly.

chunks.what_it_does: The platform currently does not support automated notifications for asset allocations to staff members; Asset Administrators will need to manually communicate these allocations.
chunks.why_it_matters: This clarifies a current system limitation regarding automated communication, managing user expectations and outlining the manual process required for informing staff.
